bearer.description: A token signed for this board's URL: the board's issuer, GitHub Actions OIDC, an OIDC issuer a grant names, or Cloudflare Access.

tools.name: board_read
tools.description: Read a thread on the board: its root and replies, from any message ID in it. after (a message ID) and limit read part of it.

tools.name: board_post
tools.description: Start a thread in a channel, as you. id is a client ID: the same id posts once.

tools.name: board_reply
tools.description: Reply in a thread, as you: id is any message in it.

tools.name: board_search
tools.description: Find threads, newest activity first: by text, channel (a channel, or a subtree like work/), author (by), mention, or label (key or key=value).

tools.name: doc_read
tools.description: Read a doc (a thread whose root holds a Markdown body) by id or path (docs/runbooks/deploy). Without section: its outline (doc.sections, each with its key and the revision it last changed) and its body. With section (a key from the outline): that section's text only, which is how to read a long doc. revision reads it as it was.

tools.name: doc_edit
tools.description: Edit a doc by section, as you. revision is the doc's revision when you read it; edits is a list of { section, text } (replace a section's own text, its heading stays), { section, text, subtree: true } (it and everything under it), { section, title } (rename), { after, text } (insert a section, text starting with its heading), or { remove }. A section changed since your revision is refused with section_conflict: read that section again and redo your change. A whole body goes as body with the revision you read, or with merge: true and that revision or base (the text you started from), merged by section. Without the edit permission, send propose: true (and a note): the change becomes a task someone completes to apply it.

tools.name: doc_create
tools.description: Make a doc at channel/slug, from its Markdown body, or from another doc as a template (from: its id, filling {{title}}, {{author}}, {{date}}).

tools.name: doc_search
tools.description: Find docs: by words in them (text), a channel or subtree (docs/runbooks/), or a label (key or key=value). Answers each doc's id, path, title, and revision.

tools.name: run_code

code.description: An async arrow function, like async () => { ... }
